# Liquid Software

Conceptual source: Valto Loikkanen. AI-assisted conceptual research.

- [Liquid Software](https://valto.github.io/liquid/): Information provides continuity. Human decisions define the boundaries. Intelligence fulfills needs, with software adapting to actual usage. [review-candidate]
- [Core concepts](https://valto.github.io/liquid/concepts/): Eight independently useful concepts connect information continuity, adaptive interaction, evolving execution and human decision freedom. [review-candidate]
- [Liquid Software](https://valto.github.io/liquid/concepts/liquid-software/): Implementations emerge, adapt, stabilize and retire around actual needs, within durable semantics and human-defined boundaries. [review-candidate]
- [The Adaptive Interface](https://valto.github.io/liquid/concepts/adaptive-interface/): Presentation and interaction respond to what is needed, by whom, where and why; how is a contextual result. [research-draft]
- [Capture for Unknown Future Value](https://valto.github.io/liquid/concepts/capture-for-unknown-future-value/): Preserve appropriate source richness before anticipated questions determine the full extent of what remains. [review-candidate]
- [Adaptive Information Retrieval](https://valto.github.io/liquid/concepts/adaptive-information-retrieval/): Interpret emerging questions and evolve retrieval structures around observed needs while preserving source evidence and agreed meaning. [review-candidate]
- [Intelligence First, Software Second](https://valto.github.io/liquid/concepts/intelligence-first/): Establish the ability to understand and fulfill a need before choosing where dedicated software provides a useful optimization. [review-candidate]
- [Degrees of Decision Freedom](https://valto.github.io/liquid/concepts/degrees-of-decision-freedom/): Higher-level decisions define the contextual space in which humans and delegated actors can make further choices. [research-draft]
- [The Self-Optimizing Information System](https://valto.github.io/liquid/concepts/self-optimizing-system/): Observe actual fulfillment and propose useful changes to implementations and retrieval structures under explicit authority. [review-candidate]
- [Documentation as Executable Foundations](https://valto.github.io/liquid/concepts/documentation-as-foundations/): Shared terminology, capability requirements and guidance preserve meaning while implementations and operational choices evolve. [research-draft]
- [Capability Economics](https://valto.github.io/liquid/concepts/capability-economics/): Compare feasible realizations by risk-adjusted cumulative net value over time, including full lifecycle costs and retained flexibility. [review-candidate]
- [An Intelligence-Native Reference Architecture](https://valto.github.io/liquid/architecture/): Compose enduring information and authority with adaptive interaction, fulfillment and governed optimization. [published]
- [Principles](https://valto.github.io/liquid/principles/): Durable meaning and human authority allow implementations and representations to change coherently. [review-candidate]
- [Glossary](https://valto.github.io/liquid/glossary/): Shared definitions distinguish information, meaning, authority, capabilities and their changing realizations. [review-candidate]
- [Research and Related Work](https://valto.github.io/liquid/research/): Original research, earlier uses of terminology and testable questions contextualize the conceptual synthesis. [published]
- [About, Attribution and Citation](https://valto.github.io/liquid/about/): Conceptual source, AI assistance, citation, contribution and versioning for Liquid Software. [review-candidate]
- [Beyond the Constraints of Software](https://valto.github.io/liquid/whitepapers/00-beyond-the-constraints-of-software/): The supplied twelve-page umbrella synthesis: information continuity, human decisions, intelligence and adaptable software. [published]
- [Original Paper 00 — Complete Text Transcription](https://valto.github.io/liquid/whitepapers/00-beyond-the-constraints-of-software/text/): Page-separated text of the supplied twelve-page conceptual paper, preserving its wording and source statement. [source-transcription]
- [Liquid Software: The Economics of Execution](https://valto.github.io/liquid/whitepapers/economics-of-execution/): The supplied expanded economics paper: cumulative net value, time to value, reversible realizations, modularity and purposeful information processing. [review-candidate]
- [Economics of Execution v2 — Complete Text Transcription](https://valto.github.io/liquid/whitepapers/economics-of-execution/text/): Page-separated text of all nine supplied pages, preserving original wording and source statement; diagrams remain in the PDF. [review-candidate]
